title: Interesting Ratio
statementMd:
Recently, Misha at the IT Campus "NEIMARK" camp learned a new topic — the Euclidean algorithm.

He was somewhat surprised when he realized that $a \cdot b = lcm(a, b) \cdot gcd(a, b)$, where $gcd(a, b)$ — is [the greatest common divisor (GCD)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greatest_common_divisor) of the numbers $a$ and $b$ and $lcm(a, b)$ — is [the least common multiple (LCM)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Least_common_multiple). Misha thought that since the product of LCM and GCD exists, it might be interesting to consider their quotient: $F(a,b)=\frac{lcm(a, b)}{gcd(a, b)}$.

For example, he took $a = 2$ and $b = 4$, computed $F(2, 4) = \frac{4}{2} = 2$ and obtained a prime number (a number is prime if it has exactly two divisors)! Now he considers $F(a, b)$ to be an interesting ratio if $a \lt b$ and $F(a, b)$ is a prime number.

Since Misha has just started studying number theory, he needs your help to calculate — how many different pairs of numbers $a$ and $b$ are there such that $F(a, b)$ is an interesting ratio and $1 \leq a \lt b \leq n$?

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \leq t \leq 10^3$). The description of the test cases follows.

A single line of each test case contains a single integer $n$ ($2 \leq n \leq 10^7$).

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $10^7$.

## Output

For each test case, output the number of interesting ratios $F(a, b)$ for pairs satisfying $1 \leq a \lt b \leq n$.
statementZhMd:
最近，在 IT Campus "NEIMARK" 集训营中，Misha 学到了一个新主题——欧几里得算法。

当他发现 $a \cdot b = lcm(a, b) \cdot gcd(a, b)$ 时，他感到有些惊讶，其中 $gcd(a, b)$ 是数 $a$ 和 $b$ 的[最大公约数（GCD）](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greatest_common_divisor)，而 $lcm(a, b)$ 是[最小公倍数（LCM）](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Least_common_multiple)。Misha 想到，既然 LCM 与 GCD 的乘积存在，那么考虑它们的商或许会很有趣：$F(a,b)=\frac{lcm(a, b)}{gcd(a, b)}$。

例如，他取 $a = 2$ 和 $b = 4$，计算得到 $F(2, 4) = \frac{4}{2} = 2$，结果是一个素数（如果一个数恰好有两个因数，则称其为素数）！于是，当 $a \lt b$ 且 $F(a, b)$ 是素数时，他就把 $F(a, b)$ 称为一个有趣的比值。

由于 Misha 刚开始学习数论，他需要你的帮助来计算——有多少对不同的数 $a$ 和 $b$，满足 $F(a, b)$ 是有趣的比值，且 $1 \leq a \lt b \leq n$？

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多组测试数据。第一行包含测试数据的组数 $t$（$1 \leq t \leq 10^3$）。接下来是各组测试数据的描述。

每组测试数据单独一行，包含一个整数 $n$（$2 \leq n \leq 10^7$）。

保证所有测试数据的 $n$ 之和不超过 $10^7$。

## 输出格式

对于每组测试数据，输出满足 $1 \leq a \lt b \leq n$ 的数对中，有趣比值 $F(a, b)$ 的数量。
